title: Ijwi ryo mu muyaga
intro: Tekereza ahantu ibitagaragara n'ibiboneka bihurira, maze uhagarare imbere y'umuntu uri mu mutima w'ubwami butari bumwe. Ubu bugingo bufite ubumenyi burenze ubushobozi busanzwe bwo kugeramo, imbaraga zitegeka abandi bashobora kwiyumvisha gusa. Nyamara, ndetse n'umuntu ukomeye cyane ashobora gucishwa bugufi n'ikiremwa gito, kandi ukuri gushobora kuguma guhishwa kugeza igihe cyagenwe. Ni nde uyu muntu ufite umurage uhora uvugwa mu bihe bitandukanye?
clues: Nahawe ubwami butari buzagira undi muntu nyuma yanjye.
Narazwe ubumenyi n'ubwenge n'umubyeyi wanjye nkunda.
Umuyaga wari munsi y'ubuyobozi bwanjye, ugenda ku itegeko ryanjye aho nshaka hose.
Nashoboraga kumva imvugo y'inyoni, kandi zakoreraga mu ngabo zanjye.
Nakiriye amakuru aturutse ku nyoni nto ivuga ku mwamikazi wasengaga izuba.
Urupfu rwanjye rwakomeje guhishwa kugeza igihe ikiremwa cyo mu isi cyariye inkoni yanjye, maze ni bwo amajini yamenye ko atazi ibitagaragara.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
